title: At the Doctor
summary: A patient describes common symptoms and receives simple advice.

lines.speaker: Médica
lines.pt: Bom dia, Carlos. O que você está sentindo?
lines.en: Good morning, Carlos. What are you feeling?

lines.speaker: Carlos
lines.pt: Estou com dor de garganta e febre.
lines.en: I have a sore throat and a fever.

lines.speaker: Carlos
lines.pt: Começou ontem à noite, depois do trabalho.
lines.en: It started last night, after work.

lines.speaker: Carlos
lines.en: Yes, I coughed the whole early morning.

lines.speaker: Médica
lines.pt: Vou examinar sua garganta. Parece uma gripe leve.
lines.en: I am going to examine your throat. It seems like a mild flu.

lines.speaker: Carlos
lines.en: Do I need to take medicine?

lines.speaker: Médica
lines.pt: Sim, e você deve beber água e descansar.
lines.en: Yes, and you should drink water and rest.
